title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2027
description:
Primary Responsibilities

As a Software Engineering Intern, you may:

Assist in building and enhancing an internal system for Google Business Page management.
Support the modernization of internal EForms using an Angular front end and Java-based backend services.
Contribute to the development of an internal SEO application.
Participate in SEO audits focused on both content and technical performance.
Assist with Core Web Vitals (CWV) audits and website performance optimization initiatives.
Collaborate with developers, business partners, and project stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
Learn software development best practices, Agile methodologies, and enterprise application development.

Preferred Qualifications

Desired Majors

Students Pursuing a Bachelor's Or Master's Degree In

Computer Science
Computer Engineering
Computer Engineering Technology
Information Systems
Information Technology
Software Engineering
Related technology disciplines

Preferred Technical Skills

Experience, coursework, or interest in:

API Development
Java
Spring Boot
JavaScript
Angular
React
Software engineering principles

Preferred Professional Skills

Strong communication skills with the ability to ask questions, explain technical concepts, and provide project updates.
Ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.
Eagerness to learn new technologies and apply feedback.
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.

Desired Characteristics

Successful Candidates Will Demonstrate

Curiosity and initiative by proactively asking questions, exploring unfamiliar technologies, and seeking to understand the purpose behind assigned work.
Adaptability by comfortably working across multiple technologies, projects, and priorities.
Ownership and accountability by taking responsibility for assigned tasks, communicating challenges early, and delivering quality results.
A strong desire to learn and continuously improve.
Professionalism and a positive attitude toward collaboration and teamwork.

Join our team and gain hands-on software development experience while building real-world applications, learning modern technologies, and developing the technical and professional skills needed for a successful career in technology.
